profile.ja: フュルストによって邪悪に改造される前の、本来の朧。本名を甲河朧と言い、忍の名門・甲河家の傍系でアスカの親戚にあたる。傍系ではあるが一門の実力者でありアスカの後見人であったが、当時の対魔忍をまとめていた井河一門の長老と対立し出奔する。しかしその後、一門の集落がエドウィン・ブラック率いる一党に襲撃され一門も壊滅、アスカを人質にブラックに誘き出された朧は、アスカと引き換えにブラックに戦いを挑み敗北する。その後フュルストの手によって人体実験のモルモットとされ、対魔忍・朧に改造されて復活する。……かに見えたが、朧はブラックに敗北する直前に忍法・空蝉の術“心転移”によって別のものに精神を転移させて脱出に成功。その後は仮面の対魔忍としてアサギに引き取られたアスカを影から見守りながら、一門の復讐のために単身渡米し米連国内でブラックを追い続ける。その中でブラックと敵対するＤＳＯ（防衛科学研究室）と協力関係を築き、日本へ戻るとＭｉｓ．としてＤＳＯ日本支部を取り仕切り、朧同様抜け忍となったアスカを救い上げ密かに庇護している。現在はクラブ“ペルソナ”の情報屋として正体を隠しつつ、対魔忍・ノマドや他の魔族勢力の動向を探っている。
profile.en: She is the original Oboro before being wickedly altered by Fürst. Her real name is Koukawa Oboro, a branch member of the prestigious Koukawa ninja clan and a relative of Asuka. Though a branch member, she was a strong figure within the clan and served as Asuka's guardian. She fell into conflict with the clan elder who led the Koukawa household's Taimanin at the time and left the clan. Later, the clan's settlement was attacked by a group led by Edwin Black, the clan was annihilated, and Oboro was lured by Black with Asuka as a hostage. She challenged Black in exchange for Asuka but was defeated. Afterwards, Fürst used her as a test subject in human experiments, turning her into the Taimanin Oboro and reviving her. Though it seemed she was dead, Oboro escaped just before her defeat by Black by using the ninja technique "Utsusemi" – the "Heart Transfer" jutsu – to shift her spirit into another body. She then became the Masked Taimanin, watching Asuka from the shadows while Igawa Asagi took her in, and she traveled alone to the United States to continue pursuing Black across the US. During that time she forged a partnership with the DSO (Defense Science Organization), which opposes Black, and upon returning to Japan she took charge of the DSO Japan branch as "Miss." She secretly protects Asuka, who has become a rogue ninja like herself. Now she works as an information broker for the club "Persona," hiding her identity while investigating the movements of Nomad Taimanin and other demon forces.

text.ja: また一緒に仕事できるみたいよ、よろしくね？　ふふっ、そう警戒しなくてもいいじゃない、仲良くやりましょう？
text.en: Looks like we'll be working together again, huh? Nice to meet you. Hehe, no need to be so guarded—let's get along.

text.ja: あの長いコート？　だって、いまの時期だと暑いじゃない。あまり汗で蒸れるのは……ねぇ？
text.en: That long coat? Well, it's hot this season. Getting all sweaty and stuff… right?

text.ja: ボウヤもやっぱり男ね。ま、そんな穴が空くほど見つめても、透けたりしないわよ……アソコは
text.en: Kid, you're still a boy. Even if you stare so hard, nothing's going to become see-through… down there.

text.ja: また店のほうにも顔をだしなさい？　大丈夫よ、一方的に仕事を押しつけるなんて、そんなことはしないから……ふふっ
text.en: Show your face at the shop again, okay? Don't worry, I won't dump work on you one-sidedly… heh.

text.ja: 敵対したり、協力したり……その相手が同じなんて、この世界じゃよくあることよ、慣れなさい
text.en: Enemies one day, allies the next… it's common in this world for the same person to be both. Get used to it.

text.ja: この案件はどうしようかしら……え？　ああ、そのうちあなたに頼もうと思っている仕事よ。貸しを作ったら、すぐにでも――ね♪
text.en: What shall we do with this case… huh? Oh, it's the job I was planning to ask you about. Once I owe you, I'll have you start right away—yeah♪

text.ja: クラブ“ペルソナ”へようこそ。どんなご用件かしら？
text.en: Welcome to Club Persona. What can I do for you?

text.ja: そうね、代価は――ひとつ、頼まれごとをしてもらおうかしら
text.en: Alright, the price is—I'll have you do a favor for me.
